required_fixes: Re-evaluate C4_PIPELINE_PRESERVES_RANKING under the frozen definition (all 3 definitions x 2 recipes = 6 combinations as per spec.json decision_rule). Producer's C4 check in analyze.py line 224 uses all(ranking_agreement[d] for d in DEFINITIONS) which tests only 3 non-recipe combinations. Ranking_agreement artifact (analysis_output.json ranking_agreement) contains only 9 feature x definition entries, no recipe dimension. Report.md claim 'tag_entropy preserves ranking across ALL 6 definition x recipe combinations' is therefore ungrounded. Must compute per-recipe-iteration ranking preservation for both canonical and per-task weighted recipes and apply the frozen conjunctive criterion before claiming SURVIVES.

Execute the second frozen recipe (per-task weighted, each task samples roles independently p=0.5) which is in spec.json measurement_validity and decision_rule scope but absent from result.json M2_recipe_canonical_eta2 and analyze.py recipe_results. Recompute shows per-task recipe mean eta2 drops to ~0.36 for tag_entropy x DEF-FULL-MAP vs 0.92 canonical, materially affecting discrimination and ranking inference. C3 and C4 must be evaluated across both recipes.

Disclose and bound the hierarchy null-control proxy: NC1 uses y-coordinate as DOM depth proxy with exp(-0.3*y) where y>6000 yields underflow to 0 and early header y's (158-272) are identical across all page types, guaranteeing identical normalized density (3.693777130463341e-07) regardless of true hierarchy. This is not a test of true DOM tree depth; spec preregmd 8.2 note anticipates this approximation. Claim that 'normalization collapse is reproducible and complete' must be qualified as proxy-induced degeneracy, not validation of the parent M7 hierarchy formula on real depth.

Correct M7_ranking_agreement reporting: result.json M7_ranking_agreement lists only 4 true entries and omits the 5 false/degenerate ones present in analysis_output.json ranking_agreement (form_fraction x DEF-FORM-ONLY false, total_area x DEF-FORM-ONLY false, all ISOLATED-A-LINK trivial true due to 0/0). Producer's observation that ISOLATED-A-LINK eta2=0.0 is a definition-scope ceiling is disclosed, but the effective definition space is 2/3, not 3/3, narrowing generalizability.

Quantify representation loss from within-type template invariance and truncated-first-20 sample: because locatable_sample tags/roles/inForm/w/h are identical within type (audit recompute confirms), any between-type discriminative mapping trivially yields eta2 ~1 in the non-recipe pipeline. The test is therefore ranking preservation not magnitude. Current high eta2 (>=0.96) does not demonstrate robust pipeline discrimination beyond this artifact. Bound product consequence accordingly to single Magento site, truncated sample, n=7 with cart n=1.

validity_findings.finding: Frozen C4 requires ranking preservation across all 6 definition x recipe combos. Producer tested only 3 non-recipe definition combos. Independent recomputation of canonical recipe iterations shows tag_entropy x DEF-FULL-MAP ranking agreement only 58% (116/200) and x DEF-FORM-ONLY 48% (96/200); per-task recipe not tested at all. Therefore SURVIVES (C1-C5 all PASS) is not justified as written. At least C4 as frozen is unresolved/FAIL if recipe dimension enforced.

validity_findings.finding: Within-type template invariance (identical tags/roles/inForm/w/h within page_type) guarantees any between-type difference maps to eta2 ~1 in direct and non-recipe pipeline densities. High pipeline eta2 (0.964-0.999) is therefore tautological given the sample, not evidence of general pipeline robustness. Combined with truncated-first-20 and cart n=1 (within std degenerate 0), statistical power is illusory; ranking test is the only discriminating check.

claim_ceiling: Maximum justified: On the truncated-first-20 locatable_sample from Magento localhost 8080 (7 tasks: 3 product_listing, 3 detail, 1 cart degenerate, elements_with_bbox 1070-1564, template-identical within type), feature-weighted density using sum(feature_value)/elements_with_bbox for 2 non-degenerate definitions (DEF-FULL-MAP with a->link/input->textbox and DEF-FORM-ONLY) preserves between-type variance with max non-recipe eta2 0.9996 (tag_entropy x DEF-FORM-ONLY) beating y-proxy hierarchy normalized eta2 0.0 (C3 and C5 hold), and preserves non-recipe ranking for tag_entropy only (C4 holds for non-recipe 3-def scope). ISOLATED-A-LINK degenerate zero on this sample, cart n=1 degeneracy, single site, no cross-site or full-DOM evidence, hierarchy depth proxied by y with underflow degeneracy, recipe evaluation limited to canonical shared-subset p=0.5 (per-task recipe would reduce mean eta2 to ~0.36, still >0.05 but with ~50% ranking agreement). SURVIVES without recipe dimension is partly supported (MIXED if frozen 6-combo C4 enforced). No inference to other sites, larger samples, true DOM depth, or production OECD/COINr deployment warranted.
